title: THE PICTURE STORES KEEP A RUNNING TOTAL
why: The research brief of 10-25 (row 17): the game counted each off screen picture store on its own but kept no total, and the party runs about three hours (one store grew once before, v32.75). One running total (pictures and estimated bytes, the peak, and the count in each store) now sits in the frame telemetry, the run record and the flight recorder run line, so a long session shows which store grows.
now: The flight recorder run line now ends with pics:N/MB peak:N/MB by:store counts. Nothing on screen changes.
